title: AI assistant on every page (⌘J)
what: On the Telegram side, ⌘J (Ctrl+J) opens the Briefing assistant in the right panel from any page: ask about the latest summary of every group without going to Briefing. On the YouTrack side, ⌘J opens an AI session about the open tickets in the current scope (at-risk and high-priority tickets first).
how: Type a question or click a suggestion
keys: cmd j ctrl j ai assistant ask ai ai panel

title: A message's work trail
what: Under the message you are replying to there is a "Work trail" line: tickets mentioned in the message with their state, the AI Agent / Check vs BE sessions on this message, the Q&A thread, whether it has been answered. Click each step to go straight there; a session step with a result opens the result right below, with “Use as reply draft” (into the open reply box) and “Open session”. Hidden while the message has not reached any step.
how: Open the reply to a tag
Click a step in the "Work trail" line
keys: work trail timeline ticket agent qa
